# sanitation standard and asset criticality roster

Case: CASE-029
Document control number: SPEC-0029
Effective revision: R2
Superseded revision visible in archive: R10
Subject: contamination-control maintenance program
Primary measure: assets named by the sanitation standard
Source finished or header quantity: 18
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 ASSETS
Unit: ASSETS
Eligibility definition: active food-contact assets with approved frequencies
Exclusion definition: inactive, non-contact, or already covered assets
Control: signed standard, asset criticality, and quality approval define the program
Effective trigger threshold: 1 ASSETS

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000029, organization SEA, and CASE-029. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from approved cleaning blackout windows; external timing is conditional on sanitation contractor capacity. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
